godot-rag.description: Godot 4.7 knowledge base: hybrid search (dense + BM25, RRF-fused) over the pinned official docs, cookbook, rules, anti-patterns, troubleshooting and external-asset notes, plus whatever Godot project is indexed as source=project. Tools: rag_search, rag_status.

godot.description: Godot project tools (narrow on purpose): read/write GDScript, scene create/add/remove node, project settings, headless lint, run/play/stop, plus the Godot RAG. Paths are sandboxed to the active project.

assets.description: Local asset generation, the first tier of ASSET-POLICY: text-to-image (z-image-turbo :8687), background removal, image-to-3D (Pixal3D/TRELLIS.2 via ComfyUI :8188), whole-pack runs. Tools: asset_image, asset_edit, asset_remove_bg, asset_to_3d, asset_character, asset_generate_pack, assets_status. The 7200 s timeout covers a pack of several 3D models - a legitimately long silence. For Roblox: generated images are decals/UI, generated meshes are imported through Studio's Asset Manager.
